findings.text: blocking: record_receipt returns without writing when sink and ITER_CODEX_CONTEXT_RECEIPT_SINK are both unset, and no code in the reviewed tree sets that variable, so every one of the eight stage call sites builds a receipt and discards it; the done_when's first clause ('every stage ... writes ... a context receipt') does not run in production, and record_stage_receipt's docstring at line 752 says it 'records what arrived' while it records nothing.

non-blocking: render_stage_prompt swallows a template UndefinedError and appends '[template did not render]', and _stage_context at line 507 supplies neither dd_context, field_guidance nor a top-level grammar key; reproduced on the reviewed tree, extraction/self_refine_user ('dd_context is undefined'), name_composition/generate_name_system ('field_guidance'), and name_review and refinement system templates ('grammar') all fail, so 4 of 7 stages' census digests cover a marker and the evidence page's claim that every stage's prompt template was rendered is false.

non-blocking: _stage_context re-implements the prompt-context shape already owned by iter_codex/standard_names/context.py:679 fetch_review_neighbours and :887 fetch_sibling_family (item, anc, sibling_family, vector_neighbours, same_path_neighbours) instead of extending or calling that owner; the duplication is what let the four render failures above go unnoticed, since the real builders supply the keys this one omits.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified the eight production call sites that reach the change: worker_extraction_and_enrichment.py, worker_compose_and_validate.py, worker_compose_batches.py, worker_review_names.py, worker_refine_names.py, worker_generate_docs.py, worker_enrich_parents.py and worker_review_docs.py, each invoking record_stage_receipt immediately before its model call.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit (14 commits, c7ae574a..c69b0d74f, 18 files, 30179 insertions); it adds iter_codex/standard_names/context_receipt.py, the children/producer channels in case_file.py, eight stage call sites, three test files and the census/evidence artefacts, and changes no prompt template text.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's quantitative measures (per stage/channel expected/present/absent, ranked omissions, 33-member cross-tabulation, both controls, zero model calls and zero graph writes) are all present and recorded in context-receipts.json and gate.log; it is not fully met at runtime because record_stage_receipt discards its receipt when no sink is set.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is every model-calling stage records the context it was given and omissions are counted; the census half is delivered (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/context-receipts.json counts 251 names, 2 channels absent for 12 of 33 defective held-out members) but the live recording half is inert because no sink is configured.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the census on all_debug job 1337814 (251 names, 0 failures, 954 s), the check at c69b0d74f (251 names, 12 omissions), the negative-control demonstration, and the whole-directory gate at 48195bc5f (8909 passed, 11 skipped, EXIT=0); the gate.log and gate-first-pass.log on disk carry those headers and exit lines.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source node's write_paths list is empty in dispatch-detail.json; the dispatch brief declares docs/evidence/fragments/sn-case-file-generation/context-receipts.html and the figure directory, and the delivered diff is the section's implementation (receipt module, case file, eight stage call sites, three test modules, census and evidence) — all within the section's expected scope, with test_source_reads.py registration explained as the repo guard's own channel.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_context_receipt.py:59 fails if complete stays True with a withheld channel and :77 fails if the census stops counting it, but no test asserts a live stage persists a receipt without an explicitly-passed sink, so the inert default (context_receipt.py:631) is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: gate.log records REVISION=48195bc5f with 8909 passed, 11 skipped, EXIT=0, and check.log records 251 names and 12 omissions EXIT=0, but context_receipt.py:597 substitutes a marker for 4 of 7 stages' templates, so the page's claim that every stage's prompt template was rendered is not true.
justifications.fit: the module follows the surrounding worker_tasks idiom of local imports inside the stage functions and reuses the case file's channel vocabulary rather than defining a second notion.
justifications.goal_fidelity: context_receipt.py:752 record_stage_receipt is called at all eight stages, but context_receipt.py:631 returns without writing when no sink is set and nothing in the repository sets ITER_CODEX_CONTEXT_RECEIPT_SINK, so the live half of the goal does not run.
justifications.reuse: context_receipt.py:507 _stage_context re-derives the prompt-context key shape owned by iter_codex/standard_names/context.py:679 fetch_review_neighbours and :887 fetch_sibling_family without extending it, and the duplication has already drifted (see the four render failures).
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is the section's own implementation, with the single tests/standard_names/test_source_reads.py registration explained by the copied-list guard at tests/standard_names/test_source_reads.py:468.
